theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_measure_le_mul_hausdorffMeasure_of_closedBall_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (B : Set (Rn N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → c ≠ ∞ → 0 < δ → (∀ x ∈ B, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → μ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → μ B ≤ c * μH[(n : ℝ)] B
